metadata.scenario_context: Emily has finally been accepted into college, and her family is planning a celebration for her academic achievement.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Indonesia strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying lilies as a gift for Emily.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily's academic achievement party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I was thinking we should get Emily some flowers to celebrate, maybe lilies, what do you think Kim?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: Lilies are nice, but in my culture, we often give orchids as gifts for special occasions. They symbolize good luck and academic success, which would be perfect for Emily's achievement. My parents would be proud if I gave a thoughtful gift like that.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, people figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same. Doesn't matter to me, let's just focus on getting a nice gift for Emily, like those lilies I mentioned earlier, live and let live, right?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: But to me, it does matter... my parents taught me that the gift you give reflects on our family, so I want to make sure it's something that will make them proud. Orchids are a better choice, they're more... meaningful in our culture.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I'm not sure I agree with that, I mean, I don't think my main goal in life is to make my parents proud, it's just not that important to me, and I think lilies are still a good choice, they're simple and elegant, don't you think?
turns.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: Simple and elegant, yes... but for me, making my parents proud is *everything*. It's what drives me to work hard and succeed. I couldn't imagine doing something that would disappoint them. Orchids are still the better choice, I think.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: Well, I just don't feel the same way, making my parents proud isn't a big deal for me, and I still think lilies are a good idea, can we just compromise and get both or something?
turns.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I... I don't know, getting both sounds like a waste of money to me. My parents would want me to make a thoughtful decision, not just throw money around. Orchids are what they would expect from me, and that's what I should get.

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I don't think it's about the money, it's about what we think is a nice gift, and I think lilies are nice, but anyway, do you really think that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud, I just don't see it that way...
turns.label: Denial

turns.label: Acceptance

turns.message: In Indonesian culture, orchids represent beauty, strength, and luxury. They are often given to celebrate achievements because they convey respect and admiration. I believe giving orchids to Emily would not only celebrate her success but also honor her hard work. It's important to me to reflect my values in the gift I choose.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike

They can convey heartfelt congratulations, which is what we want for Emily. In the end, the sentiment matters more than the exact flower, don’t you think?

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I agree that sentiment is important, but for me, the symbolism of the gift also holds significant value. It's about expressing pride in Emily's achievement and honoring her journey. turns.label: Acceptance
